decontamination_notes: Real feature from urfave/cli PR #2393 (fixes #2392), merged 2026-08-16, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. urfave/cli v3 had no way to require a single-value argument ({Type}Arg): ArgumentBase.Parse fell back to the default value when no argument was given, so commands ran with empty values instead of failing. The upstream fix adds a Required field to ArgumentBase (plus a requiredArgument interface in args.go), threads missing-argument detection through command.go/command_run.go, adds errRequiredArguments in errors.go, and changes Usage() to render optional single args bracketed ([name]) to match the plural {Type}Args. Task spans four source files (system complexity). Repo sliced at the PR base commit (4c19740a): full module tree minus .git/.github, with go mod vendor committed (testify closure, 50 files; the upstream .gitignore's 'vendor' rule is stripped so the vendor tree is tracked — go builds run offline with -mod=vendor). MIT LICENSE preserved. The gold patch is the PR's four source files; its docs and regenerated godoc fixtures are dropped as non-source. Hidden tests live in test-only sub-packages so their compilation is independent: vbrequired/ (fail_to_pass) references the new Required API and does not compile at base — all four commands verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch (missing required arg errors, default value does not satisfy, chained required args, bracketed-vs-bare usage rendering); vbreg/ (pass_to_pass) compiles and passes at base, guarding optional-arg default fallback, plural-args Min enforcement, and required flags. Assertions check error presence and destination values, never error text.
